parent_wording: support stability: survives development-shot resampling and fold perturbation

character.note: E is not instantiated; this resampling describes selection stability, never measurement error

discharge_bootstrap.draw_order: replicates drawn in sequence from a single generator stream; replicate r is the r-th draw
discharge_bootstrap.resampled_object: discharge indices only; the three blocks are never resampled
discharge_bootstrap.weighting: a resampled discharge multiset is applied as integer multiplicities in every discharge-level aggregation (FIT, BLOCK_WORST, SHOT_P90 and the 60-cell conditioning summaries)
per_replicate_procedure: retain the same candidate frontier Ahat_rec
recompute utility Ranks 1 to 4 using the resampled discharge indices
identify the Rank-4 winner according to the frozen algorithm

per_perturbation_procedure: recompute utility Ranks 1 to 4 over the remaining two blocks

aggregation.NRMSE_s: mean over the two remaining blocks
aggregation.BLOCK_WORST: max over the two remaining blocks

scores.evaluated_over: the candidates surviving the original (unresampled) Ranks 1 to 4, i.e. E4
scores.BOOT_SELECTION_FREQ: fraction of the 1000 bootstrap replicates in which C is the Rank-4 winner
scores.FOLD_SELECTION_FREQ: fraction of the 3 block-omission perturbations in which C is the Rank-4 winner
scores.rank_4_winner_definition: the canonical-first element of E4 under that replicate or perturbation, i.e. the unique candidate the frozen Ranks 1 to 4 plus the canonical support-id tie-break resolve to

pass_fail_threshold.statement: support stability is a ranking/qualification quantity, not a gate

computation.guidance: vectorize over the frozen per-cell NRMSE arrays; Ranks 1 to 3 are pure functions of the 162845 x 60 NRMSE matrix and the registry support_size, so all 1000 replicates can be evaluated by weighted matrix reductions
computation.conditioning_cost_control: per-cell kappa is independent of the discharge resample, so kappa may be computed lazily and memoized for the candidates that reach Rank 4 in any replicate; this is an efficiency measure and changes no defined quantity
computation.determinism_requirement: identical inputs must yield identical E5 across runs and machines

distinct_from_gate_inference_bootstrap.this_procedure: 1000 replicates, development-side Rank-5 support stability, S7.9
distinct_from_gate_inference_bootstrap.gate_inference_procedure: at least 10000 replicates, paired discharge bootstrap for confidence intervals on gate comparisons, S7.10
distinct_from_gate_inference_bootstrap.reading: different procedures with different purposes and different stages; neither replaces the other and the parent count is not modified

domain_reading: every quantity defined here is evaluated over the frozen explored frontier Ahat_rec only; A_rec minus Ahat_rec remains ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED and carries no negative finding
